Your score will reflect patterns in your own ratings. This experimental model compares colors and image layout; it cannot assess fit, identify garments, or understand an occasion.

02 Teach your model 0 examples

Use at least 6 different outfit photos, with a mix of ratings. For a useful first experiment, aim for 30–50 photos taken in similar lighting and framing. Rate the clothes, not the person.

Uses the selected photo and occasion above. After changing examples, train again to update predictions.

Prototype: nearest-neighbor learning from image colors and texture. Scores are personal estimates, not objective fashion ratings. Similar backgrounds can influence results. Suggestions below are general styling prompts, not generated AI advice. No external dataset or pretrained model is included.
